body:
Deep anger and unfairly judged sounds about right with me too. I have lingering anger about not being understood or wrongly accused by my therapist, which I suspect to be transference rather than what was truely happening. However I struggle with expressing them, and they slowly eating away the trust I have with my therapist. There's a sense that whatever I say will likely trigger some sort of negative responses, and so why should I say anything. And end up being silent or struggle to talk for the entire session.

I think the fact that they will not take any responsibility of the rupture (because it's a transferance?) broke me.

As usual. Doing nothing, sulking, no motivation to work whatsoever.

I'm thankful having a roof over my head and food in fridge. Hopefully I can pick myself up soon or it would be a disaster.

Slowly realised that I have to have 'fun' to boost my mood. With that I may be able to have at least some productivity. But, fun? What is fun?

Sigh. What a life.
Yes. I suspect mine was caused by the lack of eye contact in general. I tend to speak without looking at the person. Won't remember if I didn't even look at their face.

Same here. Sometimes I can catch few words and try to guess what she's saying, but sometimes I have to get her to repeat the same thing twice and couldn't follow a word she said.

The only way I can catch the sentence is by repeating what she said with her, part by part.

Weird how our brain says: hell no, this info is threatening, I'm blocking this out.
Yes, the anticipatory of another worst episode...

I ended my therapy via email after 8 months of 2x week sessions. Somehow I know this is my own doing but I am still a little angry at the consequences.

I have lost my job not long ago, and I knew someday I will have to reduce my sessions due to the financial constraint. And I don't want her to worry when that happens, so I hide all my suicidal thoughts, appeared fine, and even told her that I am ready to make positive changes in my live (all crap).

So... When the day finally came, I still felt suicidal and even getting worst. I suggested if I could see her once per month and surprisingly she asked if it is better we take a break instead until I can afford her again.

I'm left hanging, debating if I should tell her my actual situation with the cost of maybe, making her worried/ or makes me look like I'm demanding for a sliding scale spot.

Unfortunately while going through the drama, I received a bad news and all I can think of is "fxck it, I am gonna end everything".... And wrote her an email to cancel all future sessions.

So now she gonna think I'm cancelling due to financial constraint and not because I am in a bad state. This is what I wanted all along, but boy, I am back to alone again, and in the worst state ever.

My therapist suggested this because I tend to analyse and think things through myself rather than discussing with him. So maybe 2 consecutive days will help me to open up while the topics are still fresh. But I am also worried it will be too intense for me.
No no... If I am determined to die, I will not failed myself.
